CREATE VIEW revenue_view
AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'revenue/*.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
)
WITH (
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Units_Sold INT,
    Revenue BIGINT
) AS rows;
